_note: Boss fight cards for /guides/bosses. Each field is a short reading of the quoted sentences, which build.mjs checks still appear in data/prose/bosses/<id>.md.

amusing.watch: A circle is marked where Tibo stands; amusing will land there.
amusing.do: Keep walking out of the circle; no dash needed.
amusing.avoid: Standing still between the double rings walks into the offset second ring.
sources: When the hug starts, the game marks a circle of radius 40 where Tibo is standing.
To avoid the hug, keep moving: walking 46 units (the circle's radius plus Tibo's body) takes Tibo about 0.75 s, well inside the 1.65 s before it lands.
Standing still between the rings tends to put Tibo in the path of the second, offset ring.

beetle-queen.watch: Eggs are aimed where Tibo stood before the warning.
beetle-queen.do: Move sideways, then leave room for the hatching larvae.
beetle-queen.avoid: Ignoring her lets several broods chase Tibo at once.
sources: Eggs aim at where Tibo was before the warning.
Move sideways to avoid their initial path, then leave room for the radial larvae when they hatch.
One full cycle takes 6 s (5 s of walking plus the 1 s hatch), so an ignored Queen can have several broods chasing Tibo at once.

compost-titan.watch: A 1 s warning, then four homing spiral streams.
compost-titan.do: Dash once the first volleys are out to stop their homing.
compost-titan.avoid: Trying to outrun spiral shots at 17:00; they are faster than Tibo.
sources: Every 3.6 s at base, after a 1 s warning, the Titan fires four streams of shots at right angles to each other.
Dashing early in a spiral, once the first volleys are out, turns the rest of their flight into straight lines.
At 17:00 the spiral shots are faster than Tibo, so outrunning them does not work.

deep-freezer.watch: Three slam circles appear; the first is centred on Tibo.
deep-freezer.do: Walk out of the first circle at full speed.
deep-freezer.avoid: A cube freeze right before a slam, with no dash to break it.
sources: The first is centred on Tibo; the other two are placed up to 70 units away in random directions.
The slam is easy to walk out of at full speed: Tibo needs to cover about 46 units from the centre of the first circle (its radius plus his body), and he does about 56 in 0.9 s.
Keep a dash charge for a slam that follows a cube hit: dashing breaks the freeze rather than waiting for it to expire.

fryer-king.watch: Splat marks appear on the ground, the first centred on Tibo.
fryer-king.do: Step off the splat at once.
fryer-king.avoid: Dashing through oil puddles; the dash does not stop the ticks.
sources: The first is centred on Tibo; the other three land 20 to 80 units away in random directions.
Leave the splat under Tibo straight away.
Walk around puddles rather than dashing through them: the dash does not stop the ticks.

grater-golem.watch: The Golem stands still on a marked line for 1 s, then dashes.
grater-golem.do: Dodge the charge sideways, off the line.
grater-golem.avoid: Running straight away along the line; the dash is five times faster.
sources: The Golem stands still for 1 s, then dashes along the line.
Dodge the charge sideways.
Running straight away along the line does not work, because the Golem is five times faster than Tibo while dashing.

great-wireworm.watch: It burrows and a circle marks where Tibo stands.
great-wireworm.do: Keep walking and do not stop on the mark.
great-wireworm.avoid: Standing still lets the re-aimed beetle shots converge on Tibo.
sources: When the dive starts, the game marks a circle of radius 40 on Tibo's position, and the Wireworm goes underground at once.
Any movement takes him out of it long before the 2.2 s are up, so keep walking and do not stop on the mark.
Moving across their new line just after they lunge forward makes them miss, while standing still lets all of them converge on Tibo.

harvester.watch: A wide warning lane shows the charge path for 1 s.
harvester.do: Start moving off the lane as soon as it appears.
harvester.avoid: Standing just past Tibo's old spot; the charge runs the full lane.
sources: A 70-unit-wide warning lane, 418 units long, shows its path for 1 s.
At base speed that is about 0.65 s of the 1 s warning, so start moving as soon as the lane appears.
The charge always runs the full 418 units, so standing just past where Tibo was is not safe either.

ketchup-kraken.watch: Five circles are marked around Tibo, the first centred on him.
ketchup-kraken.do: Move out of the centred circle during the 1.1 s warning.
ketchup-kraken.avoid: Dashing through ketchup puddles; dash and dodge do not stop their damage.
sources: Five circles of radius 32 are marked around Tibo's position: the first centred on him, the other four at random spots up to 80 units away.
It is always centred on Tibo and strikes first, so moving about 38 units (its radius plus Tibo's size) during the 1.1 s warning avoids it.
Puddle damage is ground-hazard damage: dashing and dodge sources such as [Thick Skin](/passives/thick-skin) don't stop it, though [armor](/stats#armor) does.

late-blight.watch: Five clover-shaped pools are marked at once, one centred on Tibo.
late-blight.do: Leave the centre pool during the 1.2 s warning.
late-blight.avoid: Dashing through standing pools; dash and dodge do not stop their ticks.
sources: Five clover-shaped pools of radius 26 are marked at once: one centred on Tibo and four at random spots 20–90 units from him.
It is always on Tibo, so moving about 32 units (its radius plus his own size) during the 1.2 s warning avoids the strike.
The dash only protects against hits, not the ticking pool damage, and neither does dodge from [Thick Skin](/passives/thick-skin) or [Ghost Skin](/items/ghost-skin).

sir-strawman.watch: A narrow lane shows its locked charge path for 0.8 s.
sir-strawman.do: Step about 20 units to the side of the lane.
sir-strawman.avoid: Standing behind it; returning straw passes through and keeps going.
sources: A 22-unit-wide lane shows its path for 0.8 s, then it rushes along it at speed 280 for 0.7 s, covering about 196 units.
The direction is locked when the lane appears, so about 20 units to the side (its body radius plus Tibo's size) is enough.
The returning shots come back through the point they were thrown from and keep going, so the area behind Sir Strawman is not safe either.

the-mandoline.watch: Three parallel lines are marked across the boss-to-Tibo direction.
the-mandoline.do: Reach a safe strip between two lines, then wait there.
the-mandoline.avoid: Escaping sideways along the lines; they are long and centred on Tibo.
sources: When the attack starts, the Mandoline locks the direction from itself to Tibo and marks three parallel lines across that direction, each 360 units long and 22 units wide.
The three lines are fixed once marked and strike only 0.15 s apart, so it is safer to reach one of the two safe strips and wait there than to keep moving through the lanes.
The lines are 360 units long and centred on Tibo's position, so going sideways is slow (about 3 s at base speed).

the-masher.watch: A circle is marked exactly where Tibo is standing.
the-masher.do: Walk out of the circle; a dash is rarely needed.
the-masher.avoid: Crossing the bullet ring close to the Masher, before its gaps open.
sources: The Masher marks a circle of radius 38 centred exactly where Tibo is standing when the attack starts.
At base speed that takes about 0.7 s of the 1.2 s warning, so a dash is rarely needed.
Twelve bullets leave Tibo-sized gaps once the ring is about 25 units from the Masher.
